target: 國立臺灣海洋大學祥豐校區夢泉（2018可見版本）
scope: Independent complete exterior visual approximation review; central fountain landmark plus seven-tier base and complete circular basin. Not Dream Fountain Mall, whole plaza, measured survey, 2026 condition or print certification. Reviewer did not change geometry.

view_checks.front: Central straight cylinder, broader thick drum and underside overhang, four staggered radial arms (partly occluded), brown high upper plinth plus six widening rings and complete recessed basin visible. Closed arm ends, not hollow drainage pipes.
view_checks.rear: Reverse angle clearly separates all four arm heights; highest/third and second/lowest are opposite pairs. No equal-height two-cross substitution. Pool and all base levels retained.
view_checks.elevation: Confirms shaft/drum proportions, height offsets and closed circular arm end. One rear arm is naturally hidden, so this image alone does not establish all four. Revised spray-pipe exposure approximately 0.51 column diameter is closer to the source than the superseded 0.63D version.
view_checks.top: Four radial directions, complete 360-degree annular recess and truly spatial radiating pipe bundle visible. No solid hemisphere or planar fan. Greenish floor is an exposed recessed basin floor, not a solid block filling the water volume.
view_checks.left_oblique: Opposite oblique checks arm attachment/negative spaces, complete stepped base and continuous circular pool wall; top pipes remain three-dimensional after shortening.

revision_resolved: Requested reduction of exposed top spray bundle from 21.4mm to approximately 17.5mm relative to D34 column; builder regenerated mesh and every preview. All five revised images personally viewed; this approval binds only revised artifacts above, not previous STL 61717a96... .
date_and_version_boundaries: Primary 2018-07-28 Wayfarer photographs retain EXIF DateTimeOriginal/DateTimeDigitized, no timezone offset. 2018 is photographed appearance, not construction year.

2013 Kenny itinerary and alumni blog supplement unchanged shaft/drum/four-arm topology and spray outline only; no verified capture EXIF. Their old dry gray steps/pool finish are not mixed into the 2018 brown stepped basin.
Official plaque dated 2017-10 describes 1983 pool addition, 2004 reduced pool/plaza alteration, and 2013–2014 pool/lighting redesign.
2025 handbook PDF metadata is document date, not date of its inset photograph. Official 2022 map supports location, not dimensions. Official Life watercolor excluded as geometry evidence.
limits: All dimensions, arm lengths/heights, step thicknesses and pool section are photo-derived display approximations; model axes are not surveyed geographic directions.
37 solid spray rods with 1.1mm thickness are explicitly simplified/thickened. Exact original rod count, angles, joints and openings are not established.
Unseen drum-top recess or internal mechanisms are unknown; disclosed flat top is a simplification, not a claim of a measured flat original. No invented deep bowl.
Water jets and water surface omitted; recess preserved. Surface roughness/wet colors approximate; adjacent plaza, buildings, plants, signs and hidden services excluded.
Source review is independent of numeric mesh/print QA. Thin-tip warnings and overhangs remain; no actual print, support-free guarantee or structural certification.
